verdict.rationale: Poke is an AI assistant that handles user data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions training-data use, an opt-out control, or a data-use policy. The cited items cover integrations, MCP, recipes, pricing, account merging and disconnecting integrations, none of which addresses preventing data from being used for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
